operation: Original Kiwami 2 WPC three-hit chain, heavy attack, floor attack and ready/relaxed holds. All source frames retained at 30 fps and base speed 1. The first original BEP collision frame drives the existing one-damage-event PZ swing; all authored hitbox starts are recorded and quickstep cancellation waits for the last one. Native combo release policy and damage balance retained. Holds fit original source arm directions onto unchanged native idle body/legs. The supplied bicycle mesh is fitted to native skinned palm centres using model-surface frame grips. No new models, pixels, sound or source body poses.
